Pure resolver: parse_rows / resolve_seat / store_for / uuid_version, exported from fs3_core. 9 unit tests over a recorded pij-sessions payload, both uuid shapes routing correctly. MEASURED CORRECTION to recipe section 2, which says the uuid SHAPE routes the store: against the live registry (908 rows, pi 800 / claude 65 / copilot 41 / codex 2) shape is NOT sufficient — claude and copilot are both v4 and live in different stores, and copilot exists only in metrics-db. So the registry harness FIELD routes and the shape is a consistency check; a row whose shape contradicts its harness is refused rather than guessed at. Two further measured facts pinned by tests: pij spells omp as pi, which an implementation trusting Harness::as_str() to round-trip would silently miss; and the version nibble is read from the uuid format rather than by matching the recipe 01a0 prefix, which is an artefact of when these v7 ids were minted and ages out. | tk-c302 | Ingest orchestrator wired at the composition root: input -&gt; resolve -&gt; route to reader -&gt; pump read_incremental through cursor-state -&gt; normalize -&gt; append via the existing idempotent conversations import (conversation_id, turn_no); child conversations linked to parents. | — | — | [x] checked | — | crates/daemon/src/convo_ingest.rs @ 6a2c518, reshaped to submit-and-return at 1ab6281. Pipeline: lookup conversation, load cursor, read blocking off the async thread, upsert header, ledger_view over exactly the ordinals read, prepare_batch, append_turns, commit_poll in one transaction. Resolution is a LOOKUP not a mint: the conversation id is derived deterministically from sha256 over (harness, session_id) as a v8 uuid, so both addressing routes land the same conversation and a forgotten cursor makes a re-ingest a re-read rather than a second copy. started_at comes from the first record read, never the clock, and a poll with no records skips the header upsert rather than dating a conversation with an epoch default. Carries the accounting backstop u2 asked for: accepted + already_stored must equal prepared.turns.len() or the ingest fails as an anomaly. | tk-c303 | CLI surface: flowspace3 conversations ingest (--pij &lt;id&gt; \| --session &lt;uuid&gt; --harness &lt;h&gt;) [--folder &lt;path&gt;] with the standard JSON envelope (counts: turns_new, turns_total, conversations, next_action). | — | — | [x] checked | — | crates/cli/src/main.rs + client.rs + crates/daemon/src/http.rs @ 1ab6281. flowspace3 conversation ingest (--pij SEAT \| --session ID --harness H) [--folder PATH], clap enforcing that --session requires --harness and conflicts with --pij. REQUIREMENT CHANGE mid-task (Jordan, relayed by prime): ingestion is fired from harness hooks which run often, so the verb must be a near-instant SUBMIT rather than a read. It parsed inline before; it now enqueues. The route validates the address shape synchronously — a hook never reads a job that failed later — and upserts ONE job whose dedupe key is the address plus folder, so a burst of firings collapses to one pending job on the existing partial-index upsert the watcher debounce already uses. INGEST_SESSION joins SERIAL_KINDS, which structurally enforces the per-conversation serialisation u2 A1 required. Envelope carries deduped as ruled. MEASURED at first light: 10-40ms per submit over five no-new-data calls; five rapid submits produced one pending row. The pij sessions join, measured at 0.5-0.9s, is now on the worker side of that boundary. | — | Envelope documented and asserted in CLI tests; both input routes exercised. | — | [ac-0001](../../../plan.dd.md#acceptance-criteria), [ac-0002](../../../plan.dd.md#acceptance-criteria) |
